title: 第17章 妖王黄金狮第18章 不能离开妖墟
content_zh:
黄金狮子横掠山村上方，想要借助小村的掩护逃走。
因为，这黄金狮子感觉到了，墨老对小村没有恶意，它想借助小村，让墨老投鼠忌器。
但是，墨老却哼了一声：“还敢跑！”
此刻，墨老面寒如霜，他的身体动都没动，直接以手为刀，轻轻一划，光华漫天！
无尽而耀眼的光，仿佛一柄巨大的斧，接着天，向前劈向逃跑的黄金狮子。
虽然黄金狮子逃跑的速度很快，但那柄光斧，却猛然爆发，刹那间追上了黄金狮子。
咔嚓，巨大的光斧穿过了黄金狮子，飞向了远方的山峰！
轰隆，山峰都被劈成了两半，无数巨石滚落，让大地一阵震颤。
山村里，所有人都吓得窒息。
墨老斩狮这一幕，宛如神话，刻印在了所有人的心中！
“神……神仙……”有人跪下来，朝着墨老磕头。
也有人张大嘴，被震惊的说不出话。
不少孩子更是目眩迷离，充满了崇拜：“墨爷爷是神仙吗？好厉害！”
此刻，张楚仰头望着墨老，心中泛起了滔天巨浪：“原来，人可以这么强！”
这一刻，张楚心中生出了一种不可遏制的冲动，他想要变强，他也想如墨老一般，屹立九天之上，挥手间令妖王陨落。
而天空中的黄金狮子，却仿佛被时间定格，停在了半空中。
不知道过了多久，那黄金狮子的身体，突然从中间裂开，一分两半，向着大地坠落。
咚！
两半黄金狮子的身体，压断了大量的原始林木，坠地之后，让整片大地再次一阵剧烈的抖动。
小村里也剧烈的颤动起来，仿佛发生了地震，很多人都站不稳，摔在了地上。

不过很快，震动消失了，所有人都吓得说不出一句话。
此刻，墨老轻声道：“枣叶村的村民们，我吃了你们一顿好的，又住了一晚，这黄金狮，便是给你们的报酬！”
虽然墨老的声音很轻，但却清晰的传入所有人的耳朵！
老村长急忙喊道：“多谢墨先生！”
其他村民也急忙感谢。
孩子们感受到墨老的善意，顿时都不怕了，无拘无束起来。
小葡萄的大眼睛笑成了月牙，开心的拍着小手：“墨爷爷是好人！”
虎子也喊道：“总有一天，我要像墨爷爷这样强大，一下就能猎到狮妖！到时候，让大家天天吃好的！”
张楚则微微弯腰：“多谢墨老！”
墨老微微点头，紧接着转身离去。
张楚顿时吩咐众人：“猎人队，快，跟我出村，把黄金狮子给搬运回来！”
这东西如果不尽快搬回来，有路过的其他大妖，肯定会把它吃掉。
很快，张楚带着人，来到了黄金狮子的坠落处。
“它好大啊！”一个猎人惊呼。
“如果它的肉能不腐，够我们全村吃三年的吧！”另一个猎人也说道。
这黄金狮子太大了，身体被劈成两半之后，仿佛两座小山，倒在那里。
周围的参天巨木，竟然只能到它尸体的一半高度！
所以看起来，那黄金狮子的身体，仿佛两座金山！
“发大财了！”张楚和村民们都十分兴奋。
content_en:
The golden lion swept over the mountain village, trying to escape with the help of the village's cover.
Because the golden lion felt that Mr. Mo had no ill intentions towards Xiaocun, and wanted to use Xiaocun to make Mr. Mo take advantage of him.
However, Mr. Mo snorted: "How dare you run!"
At this moment, Mr. Mo's face was as cold as frost. He didn't even move his body. He directly used his hand as a knife and made a light stroke, and the light filled the sky!
The endless and dazzling light was like a huge ax, moving forward from the sky and striking at the fleeing golden lion.
Although the golden lion escaped very quickly, the light ax suddenly erupted and caught up with the golden lion in an instant.
Click, the huge light ax passed through the golden lion and flew to the distant mountain peak!
With a roar, the mountain peaks were split in half, and countless boulders rolled down, causing the earth to tremble.
Everyone in the mountain village was suffocated with fear.
The scene of Mr. Mo slaying the lion was like a myth, engraved in everyone's hearts!
"God...immortal..." Someone knelt down and kowtowed to Mr. Mo.
Some people opened their mouths wide and were so shocked that they could not speak.
Many children were even more dazzled and full of admiration: "Is Grandpa Mo a god? He's so awesome!"
At this moment, Zhang Chu looked up at Mr. Mo, and a huge wave surged in his heart: "It turns out that people can be so strong!"
At this moment, Zhang Chu had an uncontrollable impulse in his heart. He wanted to become stronger. He also wanted to be like Mr. Mo, standing on the nine heavens and making the demon king fall with a wave of his hand.
But the golden lion in the sky seemed to be frozen in time and stopped in mid-air.
I don't know how long it took, but the golden lion's body suddenly split from the middle, split into two halves, and fell towards the earth.
Boom!
The two halves of the golden lion's body crushed a large number of virgin forest trees. After falling to the ground, the entire land shook violently again.
The small village also trembled violently, as if an earthquake had occurred. Many people could not stand still and fell to the ground.
But soon, the shock disappeared, and everyone was too frightened to say a word.
At this moment, Mr. Mo said softly: "Villages of Zaoye Village, I gave you a good meal and stayed one night. This golden lion is your reward!"
Although Mr. Mo's voice was very soft, it reached everyone's ears clearly!
The old village chief shouted hurriedly: "Thank you, Mr. Mo!"
Other villagers also hurriedly thanked him.
The children felt Mr. Mo's kindness, and they were no longer afraid and became relaxed.
Little Putao's big eyes turned into crescent moons when she smiled, and she clapped her little hands happily: "Grandpa Mo is a good man!"
Huzi also shouted: "One day, I will be as powerful as Grandpa Mo, and I can hunt down the lion demon in one go! Then, let everyone eat well every day!"
Zhang Chu bent down slightly: "Thank you, Mr. Mo!"
Mr. Mo nodded slightly, then turned and left.
Zhang Chu immediately ordered everyone: "Hunter team, hurry up, follow me out of the village and bring the golden lion back!"
If this thing is not moved back as soon as possible, other big monsters passing by will definitely eat it.
Soon, Zhang Chu led the people to the place where the golden lion fell.
"It's so big!" a hunter exclaimed.
"If its meat doesn't rot, it can feed our whole village for three years!" Another hunter also said.
This golden lion was so big that after its body was split in half, it fell there like two hills.
The towering trees around it were only half the height of its corpse!
So it looks like the golden lion's body looks like two golden mountains!
"I've made a fortune!" Zhang Chu and the villagers were very excited.
